diagnosis: I calibrated against daily NSE using DDS global search, with 3000 runs and then 1500 more, over 1971-10 to 1997-12. Before calibrating I narrowed the FC range to 20-700 and MAXBAS to 1-5; when BETA hit its upper limit I widened it to 12. Calibration-period scores: NSE 0.776, KGE 0.83, r 0.885, PBIAS +6%. These are scores on the calibration data only; I did not test them on a separate period. The model has trouble matching the water balance and overestimates volume. To shed water, the optimiser drove the parameters to extremes: a small soil store (FC about 60 mm), very high BETA (about 12), LP near 1, and a low snowfall correction (SFCF about 0.47). This suggests the input precipitation or PET is biased rather than describing real soil behaviour, so the soil parameters are poorly identified. The response parameters match a steep, flashy upland catchment with little groundwater: fast routing (MAXBAS about 1.3, K1 about 0.29, K0 about 0.19) and moderate baseflow (K2 about 0.024). Peak flows during large winter storms and low flows in summer recession periods are likely the weakest parts of the simulation. Snow matters little here (about 2% of precipitation). I'm moderately confident in the flow dynamics but not the soil/ET parameters. I expect NSE in the independent 1998-2008 period to be around 0.70-0.77.
